skills.label: Autonomy and consent
skills.description: Recognise informed decisions, capacity, consent and the right to refuse.
skills.tip: Check understanding and capacity, explain options, and respect the patient's decision.

skills.label: Confidentiality
skills.description: Protect personal information and choose appropriate information-sharing routes.
skills.tip: Check who needs the information, whether sharing is authorised, and whether the setting is private.

skills.label: Honesty and integrity
skills.description: Recognise accurate records, academic integrity and openness about mistakes.
skills.tip: Look for truthful records and an open response to errors, even when honesty is uncomfortable.

skills.label: Patient safety and safeguarding
skills.description: Identify immediate risks, prevent avoidable harm and recognise safeguarding concerns.
skills.tip: Identify who could be harmed and whether action is needed before the situation continues.

skills.label: Raising concerns
skills.description: Choose a timely, proportionate response and the right person to involve.
skills.tip: Match the urgency and reporting route to the risk; do not let seniority prevent a concern being raised.

skills.label: Role and competence
skills.description: Recognise personal limits, appropriate supervision and accountability.
skills.tip: Separate what you can do safely from what needs supervision or another professional.

skills.label: Teamwork and reliability
skills.description: Coordinate tasks, share responsibility and maintain effective handovers.
skills.tip: Agree who will act, communicate clearly, and follow through on the shared plan.

skills.label: Communication and empathy
skills.description: Listen, respond sensitively and support accessible patient understanding.
skills.tip: Acknowledge the concern, ask what matters, and check that your explanation is understood.

skills.label: Fairness and respect
skills.description: Recognise discrimination, dignity, inclusive treatment and fair process.
skills.tip: Consider the effect on others and distinguish respectful challenge from blame or public humiliation.

skills.label: Boundaries and conflicts
skills.description: Maintain professional relationships and recognise conflicts of interest.
skills.tip: Identify personal benefits or relationships that could affect professional judgement.

skills.label: Wellbeing and fitness to practise
skills.description: Recognise impairment, fatigue and support needs in yourself and colleagues.
skills.tip: Consider safe working and supportive help together, using the urgency described in the scenario.
